description: Interactive filter builder UI that lets users add, edit, and remove filters using field definitions. Renders active filters as TmFilterChip components with a field picker, operator selector, and value input. Supports text, number, date, boolean, select, and multi-select field types. The add button and clear-all labels are localized via TmFilterBuilder_AddFilter and TmFilterBuilder_ClearAll keys; both buttons keep their text on a single line with white-space: nowrap. When ShowResultPreview is true and ResultCountProvider is set, a debounced (300 ms) preview shows how many records match the applied filters plus a valid in-progress editor filter, pluralized through TmFilterBuilder_ResultPreview and announced in a role="status" region with aria-live="polite". The region is in the document as soon as both are set. While the first count is in flight it shows a spinner and TmFilterBuilder_ResultPreviewLoading; a later refresh keeps the previous count and sets aria-busy. A null count or a thrown exception leaves the region empty.

parameters.name: OnFiltersChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the filter list changes.

parameters.name: ShowClearAll
parameters.description: Show the "Clear all" button when filters are active.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: Inline (default) keeps the field picker and editor in the document flow, including PickersPage. Popover and Auto open both through TmOverlayPanel anchored to Add filter: Popover stays a popover at every width, Auto becomes a sheet on a narrow viewport. Hosts must opt in.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: ShowResultPreview
parameters.description: Shows a live count of the records matching the filters, including a valid in-progress editor filter. Renders only while ResultCountProvider is also set.

parameters.name: ResultCountProvider
parameters.description: Returns the number of records matching the given filters, or null when unknown. Called with a 300 ms debounce while ShowResultPreview is true. A thrown exception shows nothing and never takes the builder down. An existing Func variable binds directly.
